messages:
mira: FYI — Darya (SWE, full-time) handed in her resignation this morning. Last working day 2026-05-14. Need an offboarding plan: benefits/COBRA, 401(k) rollover, laptop return, access removal. tagging folks: @ian @alex @oliver @samir

ian: Thanks, Mira. Confirmed last day 2026-05-14. I'll schedule 3x 1-hour KT sessions next week and try to land most PRs before then. Prefer access cut at EOD on 05-14 so she can finish handoff.

alex: Got it. I'll prepare the deprovision playbook but will hold execution until we get final confirmation. Need asset tag + serial for the laptop.

mira: Laptop details I have: MacBook Pro (company asset tag MBP-2237, serial C02ZQ0XXXXXX). Darya says she'll ship via company courier on 05-15 if agreed. @alex can you create label?

peopleops-bot: Automated: benefits termination date set to 2026-05-31 based on last payroll. COBRA packet will be generated and emailed to the personal address on file within 7 business days.

samir: Payroll/Finance: final paycheck scheduled for 2026-05-15 and will include accrued PTO payout per policy. For 401(k) — we'll email rollover options and the necessary forms; employee may choose direct rollover or distribution (tax implications noted).

darya: Thanks everyone — I'll do KT and try to clear the reviewer backlog. My personal email for COBRA/401k docs: darya.personal@gmail.com.

oliver: For infra access we propose this sequence on the final day to avoid breaking any handoffs:
```
1) Freeze interactive console sessions
2) Revoke long-lived IAM keys and API tokens
3) Rotate any service account creds she maintains
4) Remove from on-call rotations and escalation policies
```

security-bot: Action created: OFF-1859990123. Deprovision checklist generated: Okta deactivate, GSuite suspend, Slack remove, VPN revoke, GitHub removal. Assigned to @alex and @oliver. Due: 2026-05-14 23:59 UTC.

alex: Short checklist I'll execute (post 17:00 on 05-14, per request):
- okta: deactivate darya@redwood.com
- gcloud: remove darya@redwood.com from org
- slack: remove account and export DMs if requested (peopleops approval needed)
- jamf: wipe and reimage once laptop received

mira: Also need to schedule the exit interview — can we do 2026-05-12 10:00? If not, propose alternatives.

ian: 05-12 10:00 works for me. I'll join.

mira: I'll send the calendar invite and include the standard exit form link: https://redwood.hr/exit-form

darya: I completed the short survey already. Appreciate the guidance on rollover options.

samir: Quick finance note: expense reports need to be submitted by 2026-05-20 to be included in the final run. If there are any outstanding invoices (consulting/contractors), please tag me.

mira: Final action items (tracking):
- [ ] People Ops: send COBRA packet to personal email
- [ ] Finance: 401(k) rollover options + final payroll confirmation
- [ ] IT/Security: deprovision access per OFF-1859990123
- [ ] IT: collect laptop & perform wipe/reimage
- [ ] People Ops: run exit interview and collect exit survey
- [ ] Manager: complete knowledge transfer checklist and confirm PR closure

alex: I'll update this thread when the deprovision job is queued and again when completed.

oliver: I'll remove Darya from on-call and notify services teams about any runbooks she maintained.

mira: Thanks everyone :thankyou: Please keep updates in this thread so peopleops can close the OFF ticket once everything is confirmed.
